title: 第13章
content_zh:
这话就不对了，明天周市长不退席，我们单位全体人员一个也不能提前离开，绝对不能啊，小夏你可不能搞特殊化啊。开玩笑，没人注意，没有夏真钰他们办事大厅这些人算个屁呀，郭怀通过这两天的起伏可看得再明白不过了，周瑾宇对夏真钰有意思，但到什么程度还有待观察。不过估计是挺喜欢的，不然能发那么大脾气？
夏真钰听了没办法只好答应了，郭主任又说也不要回单位了直接送她回家，临下车前还让夏真钰明天打扮打扮。夏真钰嗯了一声没说别的，打扮什么又不是交际花儿，晚上又和李巍交待了明天的事情，李巍激动得不得了，一劲儿羡慕夏真钰的好运气，还感叹一番自己不能参加饭局的遗憾，让夏真钰尽情玩，不用担心家里。
等第二天郭主任公布了这个消息后，整个办事大厅的人员都沸腾了，一片欢声笑语，好像人人都升了官发了财一样，有的干脆拿起电话和同僚们显摆起来，情绪根本控制不住，郭主任非常满意这种效果，相信周市长今晚见了他们这些人的表现也会高兴的。
弄到最后所有人都根本无心工作了，而且只要年龄不是太大的女性全都开始包装打扮起来，还有的约好午休时去买衣服，男同事则是互相谈论烟酒什么的，甚至上网查阅名烟名酒的常识，怕自己在酒桌上闹笑话，又讨论了一些时事政治以免接不了周市长的话题而尴尬。
众人期盼的时刻终于来临了，因为要喝酒有车的也不开了，三三两两的打车去了蓝海明珠，大家那么兴奋的其中一个原因也是蓝海明珠这家饭店不是一般人能消费得起的，据说里面菜品一流、服务一流、价格一流，普通一桌没个几千快下不来，今晚见识见识以后吹牛都有资本了，更何况还是周市长请的客呢。
等到了饭店门口每个人却又都一副平静沉稳的样子，这点历练还是有的，虽说没来过可也不能一副没见识的土鳖样儿啊。
前台小姐带邻浩浩荡荡的一群人进了ＶＩＰ厅，大厅一共摆了六桌，市里的领导都还没到，大家挑了座位坐好，小声谈论着饭店装修的气派和餐具桌椅的别致，桌上摆着干果还有茶水，服务人员介绍了干果和茶的产地，大家才明白这也是要钱的，有人脑子快算了下，一个干果１２块钱一个，茶水没算出来，心里咋舌却都没表现在脸上。
夏真钰和王姐挑了离领导席最远的一桌找位子坐了下来，坐在这一桌的基本都是要么平时不受重视的，要么就是快退休的，正合夏真钰的意。
又等了二十多分钟，门再次被推开了，一个应该是饭店经理打扮的人，满脸笑容的引导着周瑾宇一行人进来了，大家一下子全都站了起来，
按次序入坐，周瑾宇让大家都坐下，笑容和煦，让人心生仰慕，略带磁性的嗓音十分悦耳：今天主要是感谢大家，这段时间大家工作非常辛苦，虽说是为了工作，可我周瑾宇心里明白大家是为我在工作、在受累，所以我也不多说什么了，呆会儿我敬大家酒，希望在座的每一位都能尽兴，我已经和郭主任说了明天开始给大家轮休，所以今晚都放开了，不要怕喝醉，我负责让每一位同志都安全到家，当然也不要想着替我省钱不肯多吃啊。
话音刚落叫好声、掌声响满全场，无论男女都为周瑾宇真情实意的讲话和洒脱的态度所倾倒，都觉得工作没白干，周市长知道他们辛苦，知道他们的心意，太让人感动了。
夏真钰都有些被感染了，这就是领导艺术吧，不得不说周瑾宇太会做人了，不，应该是太会做领导了。
菜上得很快，桌子都摆满了还在上，大家本来还存着矜持不太敢吃的心，这下总算认识到周瑾宇真不是说说而已，是实实在在的请客，于是都放开了肚皮，这些菜色平时可是吃不到的。
让大家吃了一会儿，周瑾宇开始挨桌敬酒，每敬到一桌都传来叫好的声音，等来到夏真钰这一桌时，他们这桌的所有人也都站了起来，端起了酒杯，周瑾宇虽然敬了五桌了，可夏真钰看他那杯白酒还是八分满，根本没怎么喝。
也是，这么大领导能给你敬酒就是天大的面子了，顶多就是抿一口罢了，谁还得能和他打酒官司不成，只见周瑾宇举着酒杯说道：这一桌都是在基层工作多年的老同志了，辛苦了大半辈子，前人种树、后人乘凉，我敬各位前辈！说完还只是拿酒沾了沾唇。
但即使这样每个人还是激动够呛，周市长称他们为前辈啊，这么高级别的领导，却这么谦虚，市民之福啊，于是也不顾平时的养生之道了全都把酒干了，夏真钰没办法也跟着把一整杯啤酒都喝了。
没想到的是周瑾宇敬完酒居然不走，和后面跟着的下属还有郭主任说自己想和这些老同志们交流交流经验，一会再回去，然后径自找了个座位坐了下来，正好坐在了夏真钰的旁边。
夏真钰一下子觉得头皮发麻，这个坐哪不好，偏偏坐自己旁边，其他桌的人也都一个劲儿的张望过来，恨不得也跑这桌席上来。
哪有什么可交流的，夏真钰认为周瑾宇就是在没话找话，可偏偏在座的每个人都兴致勃勃，而周瑾宇的手却有意无意的搭在了夏真钰的椅背上，更是让她很不自在。
过了一会儿，张处长看周瑾宇没有回领导席的意思，就给郭怀使了个眼色，今天跟来的都可称得上是周瑾宇的心腹，多多少少也都看明白了点门道，其中一个就跟张处长、郭主任向夏真钰这一桌走了过来。

张处长首先敬了了一杯酒，然后请周瑾宇回席，表示由自己和另一位处长代周市长招呼大家，周瑾宇这才起了身，于是张处长就座在了他的位置上，结果另一位处长就站在了夏真钰的身边那意图一看就是要座她的位置，夏真钰无法只得给人家腾地方，郭主任见缝插针让夏真钰和他一起去过去座。
那可是领导席，夏真钰说什么也不能在众目睽睽之下坐上去，不然过了今晚自己不定被编派成什么样儿呢。
郭怀却不理会这些，只让她过去，也代表同志们回敬领导一下，并说平时都是夏真钰和他一起去市里汇报工作的，现在由她做代表敬酒再适合不过了。
夏真钰不想扫了郭主任的面子，打定主意敬完一杯酒就找其他地方呆着，由是跟着郭主任去了领导席，当然大家的眼睛也得有意无意的看着这边的动静。
刚到跟前便有一人站了起来给郭怀让和夏真钰让坐，结果就是这回夏真钰坐在了周瑾宇的旁边。
周市长，我们单位最有能力的工作人员，小夏、夏真钰同志代表全体同志给您敬酒来了。郭主任呵呵笑着。
周瑾宇转过头看着夏真钰，嘴角一挑笑了：哦？那可是我的荣幸。
夏真钰硬着头皮举起了酒杯站了起来，笑道：郭主任说笑了，比我出色又有能力的同志有很多，不过是由我做个代表罢了。我代表全体办事大厅的同志敬周市长一杯，感谢周市长能给我们创造这么好的条件让大家在这里欢聚，以后我们一定会更加努力工作，圆满完成各项任务。
说完便干了杯中酒，周瑾宇也站了起来，看着夏真钰把酒喝完，说道：那我就却之不恭了。接着把刚才还剩八分满的白酒全喝了。
现场顿时安静了下来，夏真钰想着那么多白酒一下子全喝了能受得了吗？看着都替他胃疼，郭怀看了也想，夏真钰的面子也太大了，习惯性的接了二个字福将，张处长远远望着，心想周市长这算表明态度了？
其他人则再度想起已经被他们视为虚假信息的传言，陈秀珍的表情又开始阴晴变换，却没了讥讽，只犹豫着要不要和夏真钰重新建立新的关系，也好为自己的老公铺铺路。
王姐看了这一幕却叹息了，她是这里面看得最清楚的人，刚才周瑾宇身边的人包括自己单位的一把手郭怀都借机把夏真钰往周瑾宇身边推，真钰将来面对这样的包围能不能全身而退还真是个未知数啊，夏真钰再怎么聪明也架不住这些老狐狸的算计，心里暗暗替夏真钰和李巍这对小夫妻担心，这考验也太大了些。
周瑾宇喝完酒见夏真钰呆望着自己，眼里还有丝担忧，就更加开心了，轻轻的扶着夏真钰的肩和她一起坐了下来，笑着说：不用担心，这点酒不算什么。
夏真钰回过神儿，发现自己已经坐下了，正了正身子说道：周市长真是海量。说完就想找借口去别的桌上吃饭去，可是在坐的其他人又开始问些杂七杂八的事情，慢慢地引着夏真钰说话，夏真钰果然配合的聊了起来，还时不时的也和周瑾宇谈几句。
夏真钰的态度让周瑾宇觉得今晚自己真是心满意足，同时也有点后悔前几天的决定，看着夏真钰喝过酒红扑扑的脸，红润润的唇，笑眯眯的样子，心里喜欢得很，直想搂着她温存温存。
酒一直喝到后半夜，周瑾宇看大家也确实吃得差不多了，就发了话共同举杯结束了饭局，并让助理安排车和人送众人回家，转头看了眼夏真钰，还真没酒量，一共喝不到二瓶啤酒就趴在桌子上迷糊呢。
郭主任、张处长等人也表现出不胜酒力的样子，互相搀扶着往外走去，周瑾宇笑了，很满意他们的表现。
伸手扶起夏真钰，一手搂着她的腰，一手按着她靠在自己胸前，几乎半抱着夏真钰站了起来往外面走，刚到门口司机已经在等着了，周瑾宇摆了摆手示意司机不用下车帮忙，开了车门抱起夏真钰坐了进去。
content_en:
This is wrong. If Mayor Zhou doesn't leave tomorrow, no one from our unit can leave early. Absolutely not. Xiaoxia, you can't be special. Just kidding, no one is paying attention. Without Xia Zhenyu and the others, these people in the office are nothing. Guo Huai can see clearly through the ups and downs in the past two days. Zhou Jinyu is interested in Xia Zhenyu, but to what extent remains to be seen. But I guess I quite like it, otherwise I would lose such a temper?
After hearing this, Xia Zhenyu had no choice but to agree. Director Guo also said that she would not go back to the unit and sent her home directly. Before getting off the car, he asked Xia Zhenyu to dress up tomorrow. Xia Zhenyu said yes without saying anything else. She was dressed like a social butterfly. In the evening, she explained tomorrow's affairs to Li Wei. Li Wei was so excited that he envied Xia Zhenyu's good luck. He also lamented his regret that he could not attend the dinner, so that Xia Zhenyu could have fun without worrying about his family.
When Director Guo announced the news the next day, everyone in the office was excited and laughing, as if everyone had been promoted and made a fortune. Some even picked up the phone to show off to their colleagues, unable to control their emotions. Director Guo was very satisfied with the effect, and I believe Mayor Zhou would also be happy to see their performance tonight.
In the end, no one was interested in working at all, and as long as the women were not too old, they all started to pack up and dress up, and some made appointments to buy clothes during lunch break. The male colleagues talked to each other about tobacco and alcohol, and even looked up common knowledge about famous tobacco and alcohol on the Internet, fearing that they would make a joke at the wine table, and discussed some current affairs and politics to avoid being embarrassed by Mayor Zhou's topic.
The moment that everyone was looking forward to finally arrived. Because they wanted to drink and those with cars didn't drive, they took a taxi in twos and threes and went to the Blue Sea Pearl. One of the reasons why everyone was so excited was that the Blue Sea Pearl restaurant was not affordable for ordinary people. It was said that the food, service and price were first-class, and a regular table would cost several thousand people. After seeing what we saw tonight, we had the capital to brag, not to mention that it was a guest invited by Mayor Zhou.
When we arrived at the door of the hotel, everyone looked calm and composed. We still have some experience. Even though we have never been there, we can't act like inexperienced country bumpkins.
The front desk lady led a large group of people from the neighbors into the VIP hall. There were six tables in the hall. The city leaders had not arrived yet. Everyone chose their seats and sat down. They whispered about the grand decoration of the hotel and the unique tableware, tables and chairs. Dried fruits and tea were also provided. The service staff introduced the origin of dried fruits and tea, and everyone realized that this also costs money. Someone quickly calculated that each dried fruit costs 12 yuan, but the tea was not calculated. He was shocked but did not show it on his face.
Xia Zhenyu and Sister Wang chose the table farthest from the leadership table and sat down. Most of the people sitting at this table were either not taken seriously or were about to retire, which was exactly what Xia Zhenyu wanted.
After waiting for more than 20 minutes, the door was pushed open again. A man dressed as the hotel manager guided Zhou Jinyu and his party in with a smile on his face. Everyone stood up at once.
After sitting down in order, Zhou Jinyu asked everyone to sit down. His smile was warm and admirable, and his slightly magnetic voice was very pleasant: Today I mainly want to thank you. Everyone has worked very hard during this period. Although it is for work, I, Zhou Jinyu, know in my heart that everyone is working and suffering for me, so I I won’t say much more. I will toast you all later. I hope everyone here can have a good time. I have told Director Guo that we will give everyone a day off tomorrow, so let’s relax tonight. Don’t be afraid of getting drunk. I am responsible for ensuring that every comrade gets home safely. Of course, don’t think about saving money for me and refusing to eat more.
As soon as he finished speaking, the audience cheered and applauded. Everyone, both men and women, cheered for Zhou Jin.They were all impressed by Yu's sincere speech and free and easy attitude. They all felt that their work was not in vain. Mayor Zhou knew their hard work and their thoughts. It was so touching.
Xia Zhenyu was a little bit infected. This is the art of leadership. I have to say that Zhou Jinyu is too good at being a person. No, he should be too good at being a leader.
The food was served quickly, and the table was full and still being served. Everyone was still reserved and didn't dare to eat, but now they finally realized that Zhou Jinyu was not just talking, but a real treat, so they all let go. These dishes are not usually available.
After letting everyone eat for a while, Zhou Jinyu began to toast from table to table, and there were cheers from every table. When he came to Xia Zhenyu's table, everyone at their table also stood up and picked up their wine glasses. Although Zhou Jinyu had toasted five tables, Xia Zhenyu saw that his glass of white wine was still eighty percent full and he didn't drink much at all.
Yes, it's a huge honor for such a big leader to toast you. It's just a sip at most. Who wants to fight a lawsuit with him? I saw Zhou Jinyu holding up the wine glass and said: This table is full of old comrades who have worked at the grassroots level for many years. They have worked hard for most of their lives. The predecessors planted trees and the descendants enjoyed the shade. I respect all seniors! After saying that, he just touched his lips with wine.
But even so, everyone was still very excited. Mayor Zhou called them seniors. Such a high-level leader was so humble. It was a blessing to the citizens. So they drank all the wine regardless of their usual health regimen. Xia Zhenyu had no choice but to drink a whole glass of beer.
What he didn't expect was that Zhou Jinyu didn't leave after the toast. He told his subordinates and Director Guo who were following him that he wanted to exchange experiences with these old comrades and would go back later. Then he found a seat and sat down, sitting right next to Xia Zhenyu.
Xia Zhenyu suddenly felt that his scalp was numb. It was not good to sit here, but he was sitting next to him. People at other tables kept looking over, wanting to come to this table too.
There was nothing to talk about. Xia Zhenyu thought Zhou Jinyu was just looking for something to say, but everyone present was in high spirits, and Zhou Jinyu's hand was intentionally or unintentionally placed on the back of Xia Zhenyu's chair, which made her even more uncomfortable.
After a while, Director Zhang saw that Zhou Jinyu had no intention of returning to the leadership table, so he winked at Guo Huai. Those who came today can be regarded as Zhou Jinyu's confidants, and they all understood the rules more or less. One of them walked over to Xia Zhenyu's table with Director Zhang and Director Guo.
Director Zhang first toasted with a glass of wine, and then asked Zhou Jinyu to return to the table, saying that he and another director would greet everyone on Mayor Zhou's behalf. Zhou Jinyu then stood up, so Director Zhang sat in his seat. As a result, another director stood next to Xia Zhenyu with the intention of taking her seat.
That was the leadership seat, and Xia Zhenyu said that he could not sit on it in full view of the public, otherwise he might not be assigned what kind of position he would be assigned after tonight.
Guo Huai ignored these and only let her pass. He also responded to the leader on behalf of the comrades and said that Xia Zhenyu usually went to the city with him to report on work, and now it was perfect for her to toast on behalf of her.
Xia Zhenyu didn't want to disgrace Director Guo, so he made up his mind to find another place to stay after toasting a glass of wine, so he followed Director Guo to the leadership table. Of course, everyone's eyes had to watch what was going on here intentionally or unintentionally.
As soon as they arrived, someone stood up and made room for Guo Huairang and Xia Zhenyu. As a result, Xia Zhenyu sat next to Zhou Jinyu this time.
Mayor Zhou, Comrades Xiao Xia and Xia Zhenyu, the most capable staff members of our unit, have come to toast you on behalf of all comrades. Director Guo chuckled.
Zhou Jinyu turned his head and looked at Xia Zhenyu, mouthJiao Yi teased: Oh? That's my honor.
Xia Zhenyu raised his glass and stood up, smiling: "Director Guo is joking. There are many comrades who are better and more capable than me, but I am just a representative." On behalf of all the comrades in the office, I would like to toast Mayor Zhou. I would like to thank Mayor Zhou for creating such good conditions for everyone to gather here. We will definitely work harder in the future and successfully complete various tasks.
After saying that, he drank the wine from the glass. Zhou Jinyu also stood up, watched Xia Zhenyu finish the wine, and said: Then I will be disrespectful. Then he drank all the white wine that was only eight percent full.
The scene suddenly became quiet. Xia Zhenyu thought about whether he could bear to drink so much liquor at once. His stomach ached for him when he saw it. Guo Huai also thought that Xia Zhenyu was too proud, so he habitually called him "Fujiang". Director Zhang looked at him from afar, thinking that Mayor Zhou had made his attitude clear?
Others once again thought of the rumors that they had regarded as false information. Chen Xiuzhen's expression began to change again, but there was no sarcasm. She only hesitated to establish a new relationship with Xia Zhenyu so as to pave the way for her husband.
Sister Wang sighed after seeing this scene. She was the one who saw it most clearly. People around Zhou Jinyu just now, including Guo Huai, the top leader of his unit, took the opportunity to push Xia Zhenyu towards Zhou Jinyu. Zhenyu will face this in the future. Whether such a siege can be fully retreated is unknown. No matter how smart Xia Zhenyu is, he can't resist the calculations of these old foxes. He is secretly worried for the young couple Xia Zhenyu and Li Wei. This test is too great.
After drinking the wine, Zhou Jinyu became even happier when he saw Xia Zhenyu staring at him blankly, with a hint of worry in his eyes. He gently held Xia Zhenyu's shoulders and sat down with her. He said with a smile: Don't worry, this little drink is nothing.
Xia Zhenyu came back to his senses and found that he had already sat down. He straightened his body and said: Mayor Zhou is really rich. After saying that, he wanted to find an excuse to eat at another table, but the other people sitting there began to ask some miscellaneous things, slowly leading Xia Zhenyu to talk. As expected, Xia Zhenyu started chatting cooperatively, and also talked to Zhou Jinyu from time to time.
Xia Zhenyu's attitude made Zhou Jinyu feel that he was really satisfied tonight, and at the same time, he also regretted the decision made a few days ago. Looking at Xia Zhenyu's red face, red lips, and smiling face after drinking wine, he liked it very much and wanted to hold her in his arms to be gentle and tender.
The wine continued until midnight. Zhou Jinyu saw that everyone had almost eaten, so he raised a toast and ended the meal, and asked his assistant to arrange cars and people to take everyone home. He turned to look at Xia Zhenyu. He really didn't have the ability to drink. He couldn't drink more than two bottles of beer in total and was lying on the table in a daze.
Director Guo, Director Zhang and others also looked like they were too drunk and helped each other out. Zhou Jinyu smiled and was very satisfied with their performance.
He reached out to help Xia Zhenyu up, put one hand around her waist, and held her against his chest with the other. He almost half-hugged Xia Zhenyu, stood up and walked outside. When he arrived at the door, the driver was already waiting. Zhou Jinyu waved his hand to indicate that the driver didn't need to get out of the car to help. He opened the door, picked up Xia Zhenyu and sat in.
